primary_findings: Pinned AndroidX AppCompat1.7.1 AppCompatImageView constructor calls ThemeUtils.checkAppCompatTheme(this,getContext()) before creating its background/image tint helpers.

ThemeUtils obtains AppCompatTheme attributes and checks presence of AppCompatTheme_windowActionBar. Failed check emits Log.e; this exact diagnostic path does not throw or reject the constructed ImageView. This explains why real labels/icon images and original trigger tokens were successfully observed despite error-level logs.

Eleven messages per target match the eleven actual PopupKeyUi constructions in the matrix. Each cell constructs AppCompatImageView even when its text branch hides the ImageView. The full-label patch changes neither constructor, context nor number of views.

Source inspection: BaseInputView69 builds themedContext with android.R.style.Theme_DeviceDefault_Settings; InputView106 binds that ContextThemeWrapper in DI; PopupDelegate25 requests it and passes it to PopupKeyboardUi/PopupEntryUi. Both popup view classes construct AppCompatImageView. No AppCompat-only tint API is used at these call sites: they set an IconicsDrawable programmatically, change visibility and directly apply drawable.colorFilter.

Application manifest references Theme.TrimeAppTheme and that style inherits Theme.AppCompat.Light.NoActionBar, but the effective Theme of each context, including Application/IME service and a platform ContextThemeWrapper, cannot be inferred from manifest alone. The helper uses targetContext directly and its actual ThemeUtils output demonstrates its context failed this check.

Therefore the helper exposes a genuine existing widget/context compatibility diagnostic on real production classes, not a new full-label regression. Actual full-IME long-press path has not been instrumented here to prove identical effective attributes or occurrence frequency. Do not assert every device production path necessarily emits exactly eleven such errors.

adjudication_for_current_PR.reason: Changing only the helper context to AppCompat would bypass the observed contract check while leaving both production call paths untouched. Retain original logs and explicit contract mismatch as followup instead of fabricating warning-free acceptance.
adjudication_for_current_PR.why_bounded_label_acceptance_stands: Old and fixed both emit the same11 ThemeUtils errors and16 warnings. Their full label strings, actual child ink/PNG, image controls, existing proportional scale and public original-token returns were still observed, with v2 native ready/destroy and preference restoration. Constructor logging is independent of the removed first-code-point conversion.
adjudication_for_current_PR.not_claimed: The warnings are not solved, harmless in every context, system-only, absent in release, or proof of full accessibility/theme/device correctness. No complete-IME or zero-warning acceptance.

followup_suggestions.scope: Popup widget/theme contract as one separate behavior fix
followup_suggestions.candidate: Evaluate replacing both popup AppCompatImageView instances with platform android.widget.ImageView, since these call sites use programmatic IconicsDrawable and framework Drawable APIs rather than AppCompat srcCompat/support tint attributes. This is a source-backed candidate, not an implemented or validated fix.
validation: Check public usage and minSdk21 behavior, default styles/scaleType/measurement/layout, icon/plain label switching, focused/inactive/scheme refresh colors and drawable tint/state restoration.
Exercise PopupKeyboardUi and PopupEntryUi using the real production themedContext and an equivalent platform-context fixture on API21/API35; inspect full raw logs and actual icon/text geometry.

Confirm the ThemeUtils error disappears through a production contract repair while original action/preview behavior remains. Avoid suppressing the logger, adding a fake theme marker or changing only helper context.

followup_suggestions.finding: Four ThemeScope warnings per target occur because every scenario attaches a standard ThemeScope and ColorKey.CANDIDATE_BORDER_COLOR has no builtin fallback or declared standard default. Popup label renderer does not consume this candidate-border property.
followup_suggestions.candidate: Determine whether candidate border is optional transparent-by-default or should inherit an actual border color; preserve existing rendering contract, validate explicit valid/invalid/custom configurations, and avoid globally silencing unresolved/invalid theme diagnostics. No repair is included in #2033.

Actual real native ready succeeded; this does not demonstrate a native ABI load failure.
